summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its addition to the FTSE Russell 1000 and 3000 indices, effective June 29, 2026, following its headquarters relocation to Florida. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine index reconstitution event, not a special situation, as it pertains to passive index inclusion without transactional or structural changes to the company.
